name: Snow Globe
description: A glass dome on a lacquered base with a scene inside; shake it and the snow lifts off the floor, swirls with the water and settles again.

props.name: children
props.description: The scene inside the dome. It fills a circle the size of the globe; keep its ground about a fifth of the way up from the bottom, where the snow lies.

props.name: flakes
props.description: How many flakes, a few of them glitter. They start at rest on the floor of the globe.

props.name: size
props.description: Diameter of the dome in pixels. The base adds about a sixth below it.

props.name: shakeLabel
props.description: Text of the button on the base. Pressing it shakes the globe; so does dragging the globe quickly.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, a group; give it an aria-label.
